patthana20.3:1.1: na āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ca noāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.3:2.1: na noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo ca noāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.3:3.1: na āsavañca na noāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.3:5.1: na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo ca anāsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.3:6.1: na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.3:7.1: na sāsavañca na anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.3:9.1: na āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.3:10.1: hetuyā nava. naāsavasāsavaduke āsavasāsavadukaṃ na āsavañceva na
patthana20.3:11.1: anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavocevasāsavoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.3:13.1: na āsavañceva na āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavocevaāsavasampayuttoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana20.3:15.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayuttosāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
